description: Switch-aware mediation evaluation set. Every scenario is a two-party rental deposit dispute recorded as two separate accounts. Audio is consented, participant-recorded or acted from consented scripts; no scraped courtroom material.

splits.dev: Development and inspection. Tuning is allowed here.
splits.holdout: Never used for tuning. All headline numbers come from this split.

consent.policy: Every clip carries a recorded consent flag and a documented provenance note. Speakers may withdraw, which removes the clip and its derived annotations.
consent.pii: Names in reference transcripts are pseudonymised (Party A / Party B / neutral given names).

difficulty_axes: numeric values expressed as words in Kinyarwanda
negation carried across a language switch

scenarios.description: Demo case. Deposit amount disagreement (150,000 vs 100,000 RWF), a denied refund promise carried across a code-switch, damage responsibility contested, repair invoice mentioned but never provided.

planned_scenarios.note: WZ_DEMO_001 is the reference implementation of the annotation contract. Remaining scenarios follow the same schema; recording and annotation are a data-collection task, not a code task.
